<header class="ws-head"><span class="ws-kicker">Day 1 · 13:30–13:50 · Technical module 3 · serves M4</span><h2>Trust between countries: SMART Trust and the GDHCN<span class="ws-badge">Draft</span></h2><p class="ws-carries">How can a clinic in one country trust a vaccination record from another, and when is a card better than a link?</p></header>
<h3>Sessions</h3><div class="ws-cards"><div class="ws-card"><span class="ws-mod-h"><span class="ws-step">Talk</span><span class="ws-sheet">13:30–13:50 · 20 min</span></span><b>Talk 2: Trust between countries, SMART Trust and the GDHCN</b><p>How a clinic in one country can trust a vaccination record from another. Covers the GDHCN network, digital vaccine certificates (DVC) and verifiable health links (VHL), and when to use a card and when to use a link.</p><p class="ws-who"><span class="ws-t">Leads</span>Carl Leitner</p><p class="ws-confirm">To confirm with Carl</p></div></div>
<h3>By the end you can</h3><ul><li>Explain what the GDHCN is and why a verifier needs a trust list</li><li>Tell a DVC from a VHL and say when each one fits</li><li>Know which parts you will work with on Day 2</li></ul>
<h3>Where it meets the journey</h3><div class="ws-cards"><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/">J1</a><b>An Onesan baby is born in Taifafeki</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Taifafeki's document signer key (DSC of XXR) signs each DVC as a CWT in COSE.</p><p><span class="ws-q">Technical question</span>What does the DVC carry, and what does it deliberately leave out, so a card is enough without an identity document?</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3a/">J3a</a><b>The clinic confirms the cards are genuine</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>The clinic verifies each card offline against its cached copy of the GDHCN trust list, by kid.</p><p><span class="ws-q">Technical question</span>How fresh does the cached trust list have to be, and what should the app show when a signature fails?</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.1/">J4.1</a><b>A Taifafeki doctor sees the full history</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>The viewer verifies the VHL's HCERT against Onesa's DSC (XXU) before it fetches anything.</p><p><span class="ws-q">Technical question</span>Why is the health data not in the QR, and what does the viewer check before it opens the link?</p></div></div>
<h3>Technical questions for the room</h3><ul class="ws-qs"><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/">J1</a><span>What does the DVC carry, and what does it deliberately leave out, so a card is enough without an identity document?</span></li><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3a/">J3a</a><span>How fresh does the cached trust list have to be, and what should the app show when a signature fails?</span></li><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.1/">J4.1</a><span>Why is the health data not in the QR, and what does the viewer check before it opens the link?</span></li></ul>
<h3>Terms at those steps</h3><div class="ws-terms"><a href="glossary.html#term-electronic-immunization-registry" title="Records each person's doses. Often the first working part of a lifelong record.">Electronic immunization registry</a><a href="glossary.html#term-client-registry" title="The Client Registry is the national authoritative source of health-specific person identity. It is the foundational health-sector component that maintains a unique, verifiable identity record for every person who accesses or is eligible to access health services within a jurisdiction.">Client Registry</a><a href="glossary.html#term-facility-workforce-and-product-registries" title="Authoritative lists of health facilities, health workers, and products such as vaccines and their batches.">Facility, workforce and product registries</a><a href="glossary.html#term-dose-number-and-series" title="Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next.">Dose number and series</a><a href="glossary.html#term-batch-number" title="Identifies the production batch of a vaccine. Needed for recalls and safety checks.">Batch number</a><a href="glossary.html#term-verifiable-credential" title="A digitally signed statement, such as a vaccination record, that anyone can check is genuine and unaltered.">Verifiable credential</a><a href="glossary.html#term-digital-signature" title="A cryptographic seal made with the issuer's private key. Verifiers check it with the matching public key.">Digital signature</a><a href="glossary.html#term-public-key-infrastructure" title="The keys, certificates and rules that make digital signatures trustworthy.">Public key infrastructure</a><a href="glossary.html#term-issuer-holder-verifier" title="The three roles: who signs the credential, who keeps it, and who checks it.">Issuer · holder · verifier</a><a href="glossary.html#term-health-certificate-identifier" title="The unique ID of an issued certificate.">Health certificate identifier</a><a href="glossary.html#term-international-certificate-of-vaccination-or-prophylaxis" title="The &quot;yellow card&quot;. The digital ICVP is its signed, verifiable form.">International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis</a><a href="glossary.html#term-consent" title="A person's permission for their data to be used or shared. Rules for minors and dependants differ by country.">Consent</a><a href="glossary.html#term-trust-list" title="A published list of keys accepted as valid issuers. The GDHCN shares these between countries.">Trust list</a><a href="glossary.html#term-global-digital-health-certification-network" title="WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. A trust network so countries can verify each other's health documents. Countries onboard per use case.">Global Digital Health Certification Network</a><a href="glossary.html#term-trust-anchor" title="The national authority whose key vouches for the health sector's signers.">Trust anchor</a><a href="glossary.html#term-international-patient-summary" title="A standard minimal health summary, including immunizations, readable across borders.">International Patient Summary</a><a href="glossary.html#term-health-information-exchange" title="The layer that routes data securely between systems.">Health information exchange</a><a href="glossary.html#term-lifelong-health-record" title="The Lifelong Health Record (LHR) is one or more governed data repositories, whether physically consolidated or virtually federated, that collectively maintain a longitudinal, person-centred record of an individual's key health information across care settings and over their lifetime.">Lifelong Health Record</a></div>
